writing.explanation: A function returning Result<T, E> makes callers handle both success and failure. match is the clearest first tool because both branches stay visible. The ? operator becomes useful once a surrounding function also returns a compatible Result. panic and expect are better reserved for broken invariants or controlled examples, not routine bad input.
